test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What happens during menstruation?

options.text: There is failure of fertilisation of the ovum
The wall of the uterus becomes vascular
A mature egg is released from an ovary

solution:
The correct answer is __**The uterine lining is shed**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Menstruation is a process in which **blood and tissue from the uterus come out of the vagina**.
 
• Menstruation starts during **puberty** and ends at **menopause**.
 
• During each menstrual cycle, an egg is developed and released from the uterus.
 
• If fertilization doesn't take place, the uterine lining sheds during the menstrual period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The menstrual cycle is divided into four phases:-menstrual phases, follicular phase, ovulation phase, and luteal phase.
